rules.statement: The pointer, of width LPARA_PTR_W, must be an unsigned value in the range 0 to 2 x DEPTH - 1 and must return to 0 after 2 x DEPTH - 1.
The pointer must never exceed its range of 2 x DEPTH - 1; increment is explicit with no truncation.
Occupancy must equal write pointer minus read pointer if the write pointer is not below the read pointer, otherwise that difference plus 2 x DEPTH, giving a result of 0 to DEPTH.
Occupancy must not exceed DEPTH, because the full flag blocks writes.

rules.condition: When the threshold value is above DEPTH
rules.statement: A threshold value above DEPTH must make o_full_thr never 1 and o_empty_thr always 1.
The threshold, of width LPARA_OCC_W, is an unsigned occupancy value from 0 to DEPTH and is zero-extended for the comparison.
